purpose: implement server-side behavior that is correct, secure, observable and easy to change
entry_criteria: Requirements and API contract are agreed
Data model exists or is being built (stage 58)
procedure: Break the work into small vertical slices, each with a test, so the system always builds and passes.
Keep business rules in one layer that does not depend on the web framework or database, so they can be tested alone.
Validate every input at the boundary, check authorization on every operation and return errors in the agreed format.
Handle failure explicitly: timeouts and retries with limits, idempotent writes, and clear errors instead of silent failure.
Add structured logs with correlation ids, and metrics for the main operations, without logging sensitive data.
Open small pull requests with tests and note any behavior or configuration the reviewer must check.
acceptance_criteria: Each acceptance criterion has a passing test
Inputs are validated and authorization is checked per operation
External calls have timeouts and bounded retries
Logs carry correlation ids and no secrets

validation.command: pytest -q --cov=app --cov-fail-under=80   # example threshold; use the project's
validation.expect: passes and meets the agreed coverage
no secret values reach log calls

failure_modes.response: Move rules into a plain layer

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A refund endpoint validates the amount against the original payment, checks the caller owns the order, uses an idempotency key to ignore duplicate requests, and logs the correlation id and outcome without card data.
